patterns: DataExtractorService is intended as single source of truth for payroll rows.
Other income detail columns are discovered from top-level pendapatan_* fields and other_incomes arrays.
Export formulas use signed negative deductions and add those cells instead of subtracting them.
Tax report maps DataExtractor rows into a smaller MonthlyTaxRow shape before Excel generation.
conflict_areas: Pre-existing uncommitted changes in payroll/tax/export files
Bonus/Exgratia semantics affect taxable totals and take-home calculations
Employee dedupe can change report row counts
constraints: Keep Daftar Upah display, Daftar Upah export, and Pajak export aligned to the same canonical row data.
Add focused tests for Bonus/Exgratia normalization and missing/double employee scenarios.
